What Ajorin Does

Features

Five ways Ajorin makes every arrival feel like it was built for you.

01 The Arrival Brief

Personalized from the moment you arrive.

Skip the generic travel lists. As soon as you reach a new destination, Ajorin creates a personalized brief with places to eat, explore, and experience — based on your interests.

02 Home Zone + Automatic Detection

Discovery without searching.

Set your home once, and Ajorin automatically knows when you've entered a new city or destination. No searching. No typing. Just open the app and start exploring.

👋 Welcome to Nashville.
03 The Welcome Brief

A welcome made just for you.

The moment you arrive, Ajorin greets you with a personalized welcome and your Discovery Brief is ready. It's the first step to experiencing every place your way.

04 Pulse

Know what's happening right now.

Before you head out, Pulse gives you a real-time snapshot of a place — whether it's busy, quiet, trending, or not worth the trip — so you can make better decisions.

05 Culture & Community Matching

Find places where you belong.

Discover restaurants, events, communities, and experiences that reflect your interests, culture, and identity — helping you feel at home wherever you go.
